prompt.en: Which two provinces joined Canada in 1905?
prompt.fr: Quelles deux provinces se sont jointes au Canada en 1905?

options.en: Prince Edward Island and Newfoundland and Labrador.

explanation.en: Alberta and Saskatchewan joined in 1905. Manitoba and the Northwest Territories came in 1870, British Columbia in 1871 and Prince Edward Island in 1873.
explanation.fr: L'Alberta et la Saskatchewan se sont jointes en 1905. Le Manitoba et les Territoires du Nord-Ouest sont arrivés en 1870, la Colombie-Britannique en 1871 et l'Île-du-Prince-Édouard en 1873.

verification.evidence: 1870 – Manitoba, Northwest Territories 1871 – British Columbia 1873 – Prince Edward Island 1880 – Transfer of the Arctic Islands (to N.W.T.) 1898 – Yukon Territory 1905 – Alberta, Saskatchewan
